title: matter: Add BTP fragment reassembly and automatic Matter dissection for BTP/UDP
description:
This series enhances the Matter dissector with:

1. Fragment reassembly for multi-packet BTP-Matter messages using the Wireshark reassembly framework
2. Automatic Matter protocol dissection for complete/reassembled payloads and decode-as support
3. Default UDP port 5540 registration in the Matter dissector for automatic dissection

notes.body:
As said often before: you cannot assume the TCP dissector will give you complete and/or aligned PDU's. 
See [section 2.7 of the dissector documentation](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/doc/README.dissector#L3328). Therefore you should probably look into using `tcp_dissect_pdus()`.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23208/diffs?diff_id=1626453212&start_sha=703a374accdb370caca734387f850240794599b3#3508e8a7a10959ae18b39a7d4f7b1eef8625dacb_756_755)

Thank you for your quick response and pointers.

I think it's best to omit TCP support for the moment. I don't have any pcaps to see what's going on with TCP.
For UDP and BTP, I have and can provide pcaps.

commits_data.message:
matter: Add BTP fragment reassembly and automatic Matter dissection for BTP/UDP

BTP fragment reassembly:
- add reassembly table and fragment items to track BTP-Matter segments
- reassemble multi-packet payloads using fragment_add_seq_next with
  handle+direction key
- mark fragmented SDUs, show "Matter BTP Fragment (%d bytes)", and attach
  reassembly info

Automatic Matter dissection for BTP:
- automatically dissect complete BTP payloads (single-packet or
  reassembled) as Matter protocol
- register btp-matter.payload decode-as table with Matter as default
  dissector
- allow users to override payload dissection via "Decode As" in the UI

Matter UDP port registration:
- add automatic dissection for Matter protocol on UDP port 5540
- maintain decode-as support for custom UDP ports
- aligns with IANA service name assignment for Matter protocol
